facts.fact: ARCT states that e-commerce activity on Burundi's territory is subject to a prior conformity obligation, applying the provisions of the code des communications électroniques et postales.
facts.system: code des communications électroniques et postales

facts.fact: ARCT issued a communiqué on 26 June 2026 calling e-commerce platforms and merchant sites to declare conformity, with a procedures manual, a conformity checklist and a declaration form annexed; it reports no declaration received or penalty.
